name: plexus-app
description: PLEXUS MERN OAuth2 Social Login System

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm start --prefix client" "npm run dev --prefix api"
scripts.build: cd client && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('build', {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.cpSync('client/build', 'build', {recursive:true});"
